payload.blocks: Only the footprint-widen class of the when-to-ask rule and how much door change it needs. The rest of the rule (trust boundary, irreversible loss, outcome change, real ties) is shaped meanwhile.
payload.headline: Is a plan's file footprint part of the approved frame, so widening it needs your answer?

parts.cause: core/skills/_shared/decision-question.md defines the approved frame as 'which files/contracts may change' plus budget, and says leaving it means ask. A footprint is a file list, so every extra file is a frame exit; PS-24 also forbids a lead from editing its own footprint. The leads followed the rule; the rule produced the stall.

options.cost: Rule text in about 4 skill files plus the widen door (shared with ds-mzyircswox) accepting the lead's recorded decision; roughly 1-2 days.
options.does: Frame = outcome, acceptance, non-goals, settled decisions, laws, budget. A widening that serves the plan's own acceptance and stays in budget is decided and reported, not asked; overlap with another plan stays a warning the supervisor coordinates.
options.gain: Removes the whole class: none of the three would have reached you; no overnight hold.
options.harm: A lead may touch a file you would not have chosen; you see it only in the report and reverse after the fact. Needs PS-24 amended.
options.label: Frame is the outcome; footprint is coordination

options.cost: Rule text plus supervisor skill; about 1 day.
options.does: Widening stays a frame exit, but the supervisor decides it without you when it serves the plan's acceptance; PS-24 unchanged.
options.gain: A second agent checks each widening; you are still not woken.
options.harm: Keeps the lead-to-supervisor hop (minutes to an hour when the supervisor is busy or rotating).
options.label: Footprint stays in frame; supervisor decides

options.does: Every widening stays an owner question.
options.gain: You see every file change before it happens.
options.harm: The overnight stall repeats whenever a lead finds a missed file (three times in about 10 hours on 2026-11-25/26).
options.label: Keep as today

parts.recommendation: Frame is the outcome: the footprint exists so parallel plans do not collide, not to gate you; your three answers matched the recommendation every time, so the question carried no information you added.

scope.allows: Shaping the when-to-ask rule with the footprint outside the frame (or supervisor-decided under option 2), and noting the PS-24 change for ds-mzyircswox.
scope.forbids: Any change to code, doors, PS-24 or skill text now; those go through a plan after the discussion settles. It does not answer q-ee2f2g3aoj, which keeps its own answer.

parts.what: Three footprint-widen questions (q-myvzcbz3sx, q-vqyxe5oi6j, q-qzchcwl7ya) each asked to add 1-2 small files a plan's own acceptance criteria needed. You answered all three with the recommended option; the first two waited about 8.5 hours overnight and held five phases.
